svg.title: Road elements on a straight section
svg.desc: A 9.4 m horizontal straight, from left to right: barred area, checkered starting line, left side-road junction, crosswalk, and a compact parking area with perpendicular spaces. Barred-area and crosswalk signs are shown; element type labels appear below the road. The dark road surface extends 4 cm beyond its outer markings and ends flush at both ports.
